![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1105672/205160387-7c868091-556d-471d-8b7c-d6c61fff55a6.png)

If you can, would it be possible to get some more debug info?
It might be related to your hardware revisions or type.

Will you be able to run some python code to help track down this problem?

Here is a simple script that tests the new functions.  It requires ttls 1.5.1 (installable by pip)
Just ignore any warnings about unclosed client sessions, but the rest of the output would be helpful
``` 
#!/usr/bin/env python

import asyncio
from pprint import pprint
from ttls.client import Twinkly

HOST = "10.0.0.10" # Twinkly IP

async def main_loop() -> None:
    t = Twinkly(host=HOST, timeout=60)

    details = await t.get_details()
    details['device_name'] = "DEVICE NAME"
    details['mac'] = "MAC"

    print("== Details ==")
    pprint(details)

    print("== Setting color ==")
    try:
        await t.set_static_colour((255, 0, 0))
    except Exception as e:
        print("## Cant set color ##")
        print(e)
    print("== Setting color done ==")

    try:
        mov = await t._get("movies")
        print("== Installed movies ==")
        pprint(mov)
    except Exception as e:
        mov = None
        print("## Cant get movies ##")
        print(e)

    try:
        curr = await t._get("movies/current")
        print("== Current Movie ==")
        print(curr)
    except Exception as e:
        curr = None
        print("## Cant get current movie ##")
        print(e)

    if 'movies' in mov and curr:
        for movie in mov['movies']:
            if movie['id'] != curr['id']:
                print(f"== Setting current movie to {movie['id']} ==")
                await t.set_current_movie(movie['id'])
                await t.set_mode("movie")
                break
        try:
            curr = await t._get("movies/current")
            print("== Current Movie ==")
            print(curr)
        except Exception as e:
            curr = None
            print("## Cant get current movie ##")
            print(e)
    else:
        print("## Movies are unavailable ##")

    await t.close()

asyncio.run(main_loop())

```

Hopefully this PR fixes it
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/83104
